evidence.name: Screen field: Space inside each plan card
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Space inside each plan card" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Space inside each plan card
sections.description: Sets the padding inside each plan card, between its labels and the card edge, on the top, bottom, left, and right. Increase it to make cards feel roomier and easier to tap, decrease it to fit more plans on screen. The theme default is usually fine; adjust only if cards look cramped in preview.
